svg.title: Field notebook flyleaf — vernier calipers
svg.desc: A pair of vernier calipers drawn in line, closing on a machined pin. The sliding vernier scale travels along the fixed main scale until the jaws meet the work, and the reading resolves from 24 mm read off the main scale alone to 24·35 mm once the vernier is read against it. Hand-drawn geometry; nothing on this plate is live.
